correctness.rationale: Reconstructed normalized annular covariance and symmetric kernel; proved maximum at outer circle by even convex radial absolute-kernel evaluation, and L1=Linfinity by kernel adjoint symmetry. Integrated the exact negative circular cap, proving the closed formula for all radii. For strict monotonicity, c_s(u) has one-sign-change parameter derivative, while G prime is nonnegative monotone and the mean amplitude decreases; the weighted sign-change inequality is strict. Tangency at r=2-sqrt(3) yields an explicit delta^(5/2) cap and positive coefficient D; analytic Puiseux factor justifies derivative classification C2 not C3. Disk and circle endpoints are analytic evaluations. Checker independently cross-computed 462 finite tests including quadrature, polar integration, sample monotonicity, cusp ratio; the proof, not the finite tests, supports universal assertions.

value.rationale: The sharp endpoint norm is the worst-case input amplification of least-squares affine approximation. A centered circular lake is a natural parameter family for area-orthogonal polynomial approximation, so the exact profile is a canonical rather than arbitrary invariant. The strict decrease shows that introducing/growing the lake improves worst-case stability; the first cap-hole boundary collision produces a mathematically motivated 5/2 nonanalyticity with an explicit coefficient. These cannot be inferred from merely reproducing the known disk and circle endpoint values.
